turns.query: On Beijing's city-level record in 2023, count the days whose daily maximum 8-hour ozone, as defined by HJ 663-2013, exceeded 160 ug/m3, and separately the days whose daily mean PM2.5 exceeded 75 ug/m3, considering every day of the year whatever number of hours it reports.
Now count the days on which both limits were exceeded together, and discuss how that number compares with what one would estimate from the two frequencies alone.
